title: Rectangular top (2 parts)
spec:
Create a cylindrical base by starting with a new coordinate system. Set the Euler angles to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector to [0.0, 0.0, -0.0057]. In the first face, draw a single circle centered at [0.0072, 0.0072] with a radius of 0.0072. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.0144. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, -0.0057]. Extrude the sketch along the normal by 0.7614 units, creating a new solid body. The dimensions of the cylindrical base are 0.014443958055894246 in length, 0.014443958055894246 in width, and 0.7613716678250921 in height.

Next, construct a rectangular top. Begin by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] and a translation vector of [-0.002, 0.0072, -0.0149]. In the first face, draw a single circle centered at [0.0092, 0.0092] with a radius of 0.0092. In the second face, draw another circle centered at [0.0092, 0.7706] with the same radius. Scale both sketches by a factor of 0.7798. Rotate the scaled sketches using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] and translate them using the vector [-0.002, 0.0072, -0.0149]. Extrude the sketches along the normal by 0.0109 units in both directions, removing material from the existing body. The dimensions of the rectangular top are 0.018383219343865404 in length, 0.7797548871689575 in width, and 0.0218847849331731 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the base cylinder
base_cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0072, 0.0072)
    .circle(0.0072)
    .extrude(0.7614)
    .translate((0, 0, -0.0057))
)

# Create the top section
top_section = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0092, 0.0092)
    .circle(0.0092)
    .extrude(0.0109)
    .translate((0, 0, -0.0149))
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)
)

# Create the cut section
cut_section = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0092, 0.7706)
    .circle(0.0092)
    .extrude(0.0109)
    .translate((0, 0, -0.0149))
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)
)

# Combine the parts
r = base_cylinder.cut(cut_section)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch
circle_center = (0.0072, 0.0072)
circle_radius = 0.0072
sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical rod
extrude_depth = 0.7614
cylinder = sketch.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Scale the sketch (if necessary)
sketch_scale = 0.0145
# Note: Scaling the sketch after extrusion is not directly possible in CAD-Query.
#       We can scale the entire object, but this would change its dimensions.
#       For the purpose of this conversion, we assume the scaling is applied to the sketch before extrusion.

# Create the final model
r = cylinder

    workplane
    .center(0.0072, 0.0072)  # Move to the center of the circle

)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
